'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Bentley Boyd LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bentley Boyd]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
